target_customer: Pharma and clinical partners; end users are knee osteoarthritis patients and treating physicians
problem: Knee osteoarthritis pain needs repeat injections and strong oral drugs, and capsaicin type treatments cause burning pain.
business_model: Drug and device development company, non dilutive grants then equity, future product sales or licensing
product_category: Injectable hydrogel and prodrug therapeutic for osteoarthritis pain

founders.name: Alison Liddy
education: MSc and PhD in Chemistry and Biochemical Engineering (institutions not named)
founders.background_notes: From YC page: inventor on over 20 patent publications and winner of Science Foundation Ireland 1 million euro innovation prize.

competitors.name: Centrexion Therapeutics (CNTX-4975)
competitors.what: Intra-articular trans-capsaicin injection for knee osteoarthritis pain, a TRPV1 approach
competitors.traction_then: Phase 3 VICTORY program completed enrollment before 2022; Fast Track designation Jan 2018

technical_complexity.rationale: Developing a new injectable drug delivery gel requires preclinical safety work, manufacturing and clinical trials.

defensibility.rationale: Patents and the clinical and regulatory pathway are hard to copy, but the approach competes with an FDA fast tracked capsaicin injectable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Relevium stayed independent and active through 2024 coverage.

market_need_then: YC page cites about 5 million US patients, 770 dollars insurance payment per six month treatment, and opioid use in progressive disease.

branding.brand_signature: Hydrobloc as the product name for RM-010

brand_strength.rationale: Only grant and trade coverage; other firms called Relevium or Relievant exist and no brand assets were found.

outcome_analysis: Relevium Medical has funded itself through non dilutive money, including a 4.6 million euro DTIF award announced in November 2024, while planning a 10 million euro Series A for clinical trials. No Series A close or trial readout was found, so its progress past preclinical is unconfirmed. Capital intensity and clinical risk define the path.
notes: The DTIF award is 4.6 million euro; amount_usd left null as no stated dollar figure. Reported once in search snippets and unverified as a round: 2 million euro EIC award in 2022, total raised 3.4 million euro by June 2024, YC page says 3.7 million dollars non dilutive. A database lists 5.34M dollars total, unverified. Founding year 2019 appears only in an aggregator, so null. Competitor coverage dated 2018 relates to the field before the batch; Centrexion's later status not checked. Relevium site is a different description (TRPV1 ablation prodrug) than the hydrogel in YC copy.
